summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Algeria Chronicles Encyclopedia frontend application. All major features are working correctly with excellent 18th century atlas visual design.

ui_bugs.issue: Minor viewport positioning issue with drawer close button when drawer is open - click occasionally fails due to element being outside viewport
ui_bugs.workaround: Escape key or overlay click works as alternative

ui_bugs.issue: Search overlay occasionally remains open after navigation, blocking other interactions

passed_tests: Header navigation between all sections (Accueil, Périodes, Atlas, Peuples, Villes, Personnages, Arts)
Interactive timeline with clickable historical periods
Home page hero section with CTA button functionality
Section cards grid navigation (9 sections tested)
Featured articles opening drawer with personnage details
Search functionality with real-time results (tested with 'Massinissa')
Personnages page search and period filter functionality
Personnages cards opening drawer with detailed biographies
Villes page with city and site cards functionality
Interactive SVG map of Algeria with clickable elements
Périodes page with period selection and detailed content display
Arts & Culture page with 4 working tabs (Architecture, Musique, Littérature, Cinéma)
Drawer functionality for personnages, villes, sites, and periods
Mobile responsiveness with hamburger menu navigation
Beautiful 18th century atlas visual design consistency across all pages

action_item_for_main_agent.drawer_positioning: Fix drawer close button viewport positioning to ensure it's always clickable
action_item_for_main_agent.search_overlay: Ensure search overlay properly closes when navigating between sections
action_item_for_main_agent.glossaire_testing: Complete Glossaire page testing - navigation timeout prevented full testing
